key_insight: A multi-agent deep research AI pipeline can automatically scout and evaluate drug assets disclosed in regional, non-English channels, substantially expanding global coverage for investing and business development. This approach reduces blind spots from fragmented international disclosures and speeds early-stage evaluation.
problem_solved: Missed or late discovery of promising drug assets due to geographic and language fragmentation of patents, regional disclosures, and scholarly output, which impedes timely investment and business-development decisions.
method: Multi-agent pipeline that performs cross-lingual retrieval from regional patent offices, preprints, local journals, and corporate disclosures to collect candidate assets.
Domain-aware NLP: entity extraction, patent/literature parsing, LLM-based summarization and provenance tracking, plus relevance scoring and uncertainty estimation to rank prospects.
Human-in-the-loop validation and automated due-diligence checks to convert surfaced leads into actionable investment/BD opportunities.
impact: Provides a practical blueprint for AI/ML teams to build scalable, multilingual asset-discovery systems that improve recall of global innovation and shorten time-to-decision for investors and BD teams. It demonstrates effective integration of retrieval, LLM reasoning, and domain tooling for high-value enterprise use cases.
visual_elements: World heatmap showing regional patent and disclosure density (highlight non-English sources like China, India, EU regions).
End-to-end pipeline diagram of the multi-agent system: sources → retrieval → parsing → summarization → scoring → human review.
Before/after bar chart comparing asset discovery coverage and time-to-identification versus traditional/manual workflows.
Sample asset card mockup showing summary, key claims, provenance links, relevance score, and recommended next steps.
paper_title: Hunt Globally: Deep Research AI Agents for Drug Asset Scouting in Investing, Business Development, and Search & Evaluation
paper_authors: Alisa Vinogradova, Vlad Vinogradov, Luba Greenwood, Ilya Yasny, Dmitry Kobyzev
